sourceFiles.excerpt: Suppose a sensor bracket must place two pins 50.0 ± 0.2 mm apart and accept an M4 fastener through a 4.2 mm clearance hole. Print a coupon containing the holes before the whole bracket, measure it with calipers, and test the actual pin and screw. If the measured spacing is 50.3 mm, the result fails even if the screw can be forced through.

references.sourceExcerpt: Additive manufacturing (or 3D printing) fabricates parts by building them up layer-by-layer (as opposed to cutting material away or molding it).
